name: heroku-metrics-alert-system
description: Receives a Heroku log drain and tracks dyno/Postgres/Redis/Kafka metrics with threshold alerts.

DRAIN_TOKEN.description: Shared secret required as a query param on the log drain URL (https://<app>.herokuapp.com/log-drain?token=...)

MONITORED_APP_NAME.description: Name of the Heroku app being monitored (for display on the dashboard)
